This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Darth Vader (V) (Set 0, Original)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Darth Vader (V) (Set 0, Original)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-vader-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 6 August 2016.</ref>. Dated by 6 August 2016 (the earliest preserved copy of the Set 0 slip sheet); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Darth Vader (V) (Set 0, Original) first published}} Text: “[Pilot] 3. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition &lt; 5. During battle at same system (twice if with a Black Squadron pilot), may cumulatively subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Vader (V)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-vader-1">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 1. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 4 July 2017.</ref>. Dated by 4 July 2017 (the earliest preserved copy of the errata slip); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Darth Vader (V) (Set 0, Original) first published}} The PC card image of 8 July 2018 (Holotable commit 022435b) prints the same text with the “E” mark. Text: “[Pilot] 3. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition &lt; 5. During battle at same system (twice if with your Black Squadron pilot), may cumulatively subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “your”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-vader-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/darthvader.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “[Pilot] 3. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition &lt; 5. During battle at same system (twice if with your Black Squadron pilot), may cumulatively subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.

|combos=* [[Darth Vader (V)]] + [[I Have You Now]] Add one battle destiny (two if Rebel is [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]) if a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json official Dark card data], Darth Vader (V).</ref>
* [[Darth Vader (V)]] + [[Force Field]] Cancels an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon.
* To fully utilize [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s text, pair him with a Black Squadron pilot:
* [[DS-61-2]]
* [[DS-61-3]]
* [[DS-61-4]]
* [[DS-61-5]]
* [[Reserve Pilot]]
* Any character (not permanent pilot) piloting a Black Squadron starship
|rulings=* Permanent pilots (e.g. [[Black 11]]) never count as Black Squadron.<ref name="scomp" />
* Any pilot character (e.g. [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]]) becomes a Black Squadron pilot while they are piloting a Black Squadron starship.
* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] only looks for ''your'' Black Squadron pilot, not an opponent's Black Squadron pilot.
